characters.summary: Future Flash is a hardened, older version of Barry Allen who uses brutal, lethal applications of the Speed Force. He manipulates time-space mechanics and inflicts horrific physiological damage like forcing cells to vibrate apart.
weaknesses: Psychological instability due to trauma and guilt
limitations: Creates catastrophic temporal paradoxes when altering past events
characters.formDifferences: Wears a scarred, armored blue-accented suit and possesses a ruthless, fatal approach to justice instead of traditional heroic restraint.

sources.supports: General identity of Barry Allen and alternative timeline iterations.
Future Flash abilities including time travel and lethal speed force usage.

feats.claim: Traveled twenty years into the past to murder historical rogues and younger versions of villains.
Disintegrated Wally West by forcing his body's molecules to vibrate violently apart.

notableResults.note: Defeated when present-day Barry outmaneuvered his future counterpart's temporal manipulation.

conditional.dependsOn: Access to extreme temporal Speed Force currents

campaignTags.claim: Uses the Speed Force to hover and propel through the air.
Capable of jumping through time and dimensional barriers.

unknowns: The exact upper limit of temporal endurance before erasing himself from the timeline.

characters.summary: Wally West is widely considered the fastest person to have held the title of the Flash, possessing a uniquely profound connection to the Speed Force. He fights by overwhelming opponents with kinetic energy manipulation, relativistic mass attacks, and versatile speed applications.

mechanisms: Speed Force aura protecting against friction and G-forces

weaknesses: Vulnerability to absolute zero temperature zones that slow down molecular movement
limitations: Can lose connection to the Speed Force if emotionally compromised or drained of kinetic energy

sources.supports: History, abilities, and status of Wally West as the Flash.
Speed Force mastery feats including the Infinite Mass Punch.

feats.claim: Outran instantaneous teleportation across the universe in a race against cosmic entities.

notableResults.note: Won after tapping into an unprecedented level of the Speed Force to match Zoom's time-dilation.

campaignTags.claim: Uses kinetic energy to hover and maneuver in mid-air.
Can traverse vast cosmic distances instantaneously using pure speed.

unknowns: Exact ceiling of maximum speed when untethered from physical constraints.
Unverified (cited source failed the automatic check): Delivered an Infinite Mass Punch accelerating close to the speed of light, leveling a continent-sized threat.

weaknesses: Vulnerability to mental corruption from absorbing infinite universal data

weaknesses: Requires a human host to temper his wrath
Vulnerable to high-tier magic and divine decrees from the Presence

characters.summary: Harvey Dent, formerly Gotham's upright District Attorney, is Two-Face, a ruthless crime boss obsessed with duality and chance. He fights using dual pistols, Tommy guns, and explosive coin gimmicks, driven by a psychopathic reliance on his scarred two-headed coin.
weaknesses: Paralyzing psychological compulsion to let his scar-faced coin flip dictate his actions
limitations: Human physical conditioning with no superhuman powers

sources.supports: History, criminal MO, and background of Harvey Dent as Two-Face.

feats.claim: Successfully took over multiple major crime families in Gotham City through coordinated assassinations.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Batman exploited his coin-toss obsession to create hesitation.

unknowns: Whether psychological rehabilitation can permanently suppress the Two-Face persona.
Unverified campaign tag gadgets (cited source failed the automatic check): Uses customized scarred coins rigged with explosives and specialized firearms.

weaknesses: Vulnerability if separated from the Tantu Totem
limitations: Strains her mind and body if channeling too many disparate or apex animal traits at once

characters.summary: Diana of Themyscira is an Amazon warrior princess endowed with divine Olympian gifts, superhuman strength, combat mastery, and iconic magical armament including the Lasso of Truth. She engages enemies in fierce hand-to-hand combat and deflects projectiles with her indestructible bracelets.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to piercing weapons wielded with sufficient superhuman force despite high durability
limitations: Can be bound or restrained if her hands are locked by specific magical implements

limitations: Prone to strategic overextension due to aggressive bloodlust
